turns.question: I'd love to hear about your coffee routine—so think back to a recent time when you made a change, whether that was trying a different brand, switching how you make it, or even just deciding to grab coffee from somewhere new instead of your usual spot. What was going on that made you decide to try something different?
turns.response: Honestly, I switched to a french press like two months ago because my old coffee maker just kind of died. I wasn't really looking to change anything, it just happened. But then I figured I might as well try something different since I was buying new equipment anyway, and a coworker had one and said it was pretty good.

turns.question: When your old coffee maker died, what was the biggest hassle about suddenly not having it?
turns.response: Honestly, the mornings were just rough. I couldn't just grab a cup before work, so I either had to go out and buy one or just skip it and feel kind of off the whole day.
